title: Rearrange a given linked list in-place
inputFormat:
Implement rearrange(head). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
Linked lists use value arrays. The editor passes nodes with val and next properties; [] becomes null.
outputFormat:
Modify argument 1 in place. The editor compares its final value; the function return value is ignored.
Returned list heads are displayed as value arrays; a null head is [].
